summary: Lake County, MN Superior NF lookout: county list gives a 100 ft ladder tower, with a 1986 note saying it is now dismantled; a 1955 USGS map names it; site today undescribed.

facts.design: Ladder tower per county list (100 ft); 1934 survey notes quoted in the same entry describe a 112 ft steel tower
facts.status_note: County list's 1986 note says now dismantled (removal date not given); no source read describes the site now
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (county list); Superior National Forest (Forest Lookouts)

events.note: Survey notes from 1934, quoted in the county list, describe a 112-foot steel tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county table gives a 100 ft ladder tower; the 1934 survey note quoted in the same entry gives 112 ft of steel. The story reports both figures and does not choose between them.

sources.title: 1955 Map of Cramer, Lake No. 1, MN (USGS topo, published 1957)

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone is supported by the county list (1986 note: now dismantled; the removal date itself is not given) and the FFLOS index. Height and design conflict (100 ft ladder vs 112 ft steel) is unresolved; no build year appears in any source read. No photos. Two web searches used.
